result.topic_en: Pencil draft on choosing additive constants in the functions $u_\mu$ (via $e_\mu = \sum \alpha_\mu^{(\nu)} + k_\mu$) so that the theta-type function $\vartheta(v_1,\dots,v_p)$ vanishes at given points, with a note defining congruent systems of $p$ quantities, followed by a draft letter dated Göttingen 27 May 1857.

methods.what: Substituting $v_\mu = u_\mu - \sum \alpha_\mu^{(\nu)} - k_\mu$ into the theta series gives a function vanishing at the points $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_p$
methods.quote:
Demnach muss man in $\vartheta(v_1, v_2, \dots, v_p)$, um eine Function zu erhalten die für die Punkte $\eta_1, \eta_2, \dots \eta_p$
[-...-] Null wird, für $v_\mu$ den Ausdruck $u_\mu - \sum \alpha_\mu^{(\nu)} - k_\mu$ substituiren.

methods.what: Shifting the additive constant of $u_\mu$ by $k_\mu$ shifts $u_\mu-\sum\alpha$ by $-(p-1)k_\mu$, allowing $k_\mu$ to be absorbed
Normalization of additive constants so that $\vartheta(u - \sum\alpha)$ vanishes to first order at $\eta_1,\dots,\eta_p$
methods.quote:
in der Reihe $\vartheta(v_1, v_2, \dots v_p)$ eine Function erhält, die für die Punkte $\eta_1, \eta_2, \dots, \eta_p$ unendlich klein von
der ersten Ordnung wird.
